tools.title: Clockify
tools.summary: Time tracking and timesheets with projects, clients and reports.

servers.name: Clockify MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Start and stop timers, log and edit time entries, create clients, projects, tasks and tags, summary, detailed and attendance reports.

tools.notes: The personal API key goes in an 'x-api-key' header, and EU workspaces add a 'region: EU' header. The help page carries a 'COMING SOON' banner, so availability may be partial.

tools.title: Gryzzly
tools.summary: Time, budget and project profitability tracking, with time entry from Slack and Microsoft Teams.
tools.notes: No MCP server found on 2026-11-21 (none on gryzzly.io, none in the MCP registry); use the public API. The site is gryzzly.io, not gryzzly.com (gryzzly.com serves a certificate for another host).

tools.title: Harvest
tools.summary: Time tracking, expenses and invoicing for teams.
tools.notes: Not verified: the Harvest support article returned 403 on 2026-11-21; URL and the 'claude mcp add --transport http' setup come from search excerpts of that vendor page, and the auth method (likely OAuth, added as a URL-only custom connector) is inferred. Harvest announces an MCP server (Harvest MCP); its endpoint could not be read on its own documentation on 2026-11-21, so it is not listed.

tools.title: Tempo Timesheets
tools.summary: Time tracking and timesheets inside Jira, with capacity planning and cost tracking add-ons.

servers.name: Tempo MCP Server

settings.name: tempo_api_host
settings.description: Tempo Timesheets: your tempo api host, without https://

servers.capabilities: Read-only access to worklogs, timesheet approvals, accounts, customers, periods, teams; plus Capacity Planner and Financial Manager data when licensed.

tools.notes: Tempo Cloud only; read-only. A Tempo admin requests enablement from Tempo Support, then copies the instance-specific address from Tempo Settings > Data Access > MCP Server and creates an OAuth app; API-token auth is optional. Pair with the Atlassian MCP server to resolve account IDs.

tools.title: Timely
tools.notes: No vendor MCP server found on 2026-11-21; only third-party hosted connectors (Zapier, Composio, Boomi) and a very small community server. Use the OAuth REST API (docs moved from dev.timelyapp.com to developer.timely.com in April 2026).

tools.title: Toggl Track
tools.summary: Time tracking with timers, projects, clients and reports.

servers.name: Toggl MCP Server (remote)
servers.capabilities: Tasks, projects, time entries (start, stop, create, update), time blocks, reports and workspace members.

servers.name: Toggl MCP Server (local)
servers.capabilities: Same tools as the remote server; browser sign-in, session stored locally.

tools.notes: The official server is documented in the 'Toggl 2.0' knowledge base and the docs do not say it reads Toggl Track accounts; a Toggl Track community thread still requested a Track MCP server in 2026. Confirm before recommending it to Track users; otherwise use the Track API v9.
